notes: Offline GRLLM.beam_search_v1; max_concurrency=1 and 4 prompts per call, so E2E is the wall time of the batched call rather than of one request.
Canonical E2E is measured before diagnostic sampling with one outer perf_counter_ns and no internal monkeypatch or profiler.
Each canonical sample is a cold-cache call followed by an identical warm-cache call.
Offline E2E excludes HTTP, SSE, serialization, and network round-trip overhead.

Internal stage values come from a smaller post-canonical diagnostic sample that brackets Prefill and Decode with four CUDA events on the engine compute stream; it reports only E2E, Prefill, and Decode, and never contributes to the official E2E trend.
V1 Prefill and Decode are CUDA device-timeline intervals on one FIFO compute stream, so they are additive and sum with host_overhead back to E2E; Decode absorbs device idle inside the Decode stage.

phase_definition.e2e: unmodified direct GRLLM.beam_search_v1 call start through CUDA-complete return
phase_definition.cache_protocol: paired cold miss followed by identical warm hit
phase_definition.internal_stages: reported separately from post-canonical diagnostic samples

stage_phase_definition.e2e: instrumented direct v1 call start through return
stage_phase_definition.prefill: CUDA event interval on the engine compute stream: entry to the PREFILL GPUBeamStageRunner.execute through output-producing PREFILL sample completion; excludes frontend dispatch
stage_phase_definition.decode: CUDA event interval on the engine compute stream: entry to the first DECODE GPUBeamStageRunner.execute through the last Decode sample completion; excludes Prefill by stream ordering and includes device idle inside Decode
stage_phase_definition.prefill_gpu_compute: sum of CUDA event intervals from the first Prefill model-forward enqueue through the PREFILL GPUBeamStageRunner.execute return, plus the output-producing sample/beam initialization window; excludes dispatch and the execute-to-sample gap, and is an upper bound on Prefill GPU busy time because the host tail after the last enqueue falls inside it
stage_phase_definition.decode_gpu_compute: sum of per-stage CUDA event intervals covering Decode graph replay and sample/beam advance, or the eager Decode forward when the beam graph is disabled; excludes CPU prepare, inter-stage queue gaps, and the per-dispatch model.compute_logits that runs outside the replayed graph and therefore lands in Decode device idle
stage_phase_definition.device_idle: device stage span minus the measured GPU compute clusters; a residual rather than an independent measurement, holding CPU launch bubbles, queue waits, and any GPU work outside those windows
stage_phase_definition.prefill_dispatch: host wall from the post-synchronize submit anchor through entry to the PREFILL GPUBeamStageRunner.execute; a subset of host_overhead, so it must not be added to prefill_gpu_compute, decode_gpu_compute, and host_overhead
stage_phase_definition.prefill_cpu_lead: host look-ahead depth: how far the CPU had advanced into first-Decode preparation before the GPU finished Prefill
stage_phase_definition.host_overhead: e2e minus both device intervals: frontend dispatch, EngineCore queueing, and terminal collection; the asynchronous-scheduling signal, and the one host term Prefill dispatch is already inside
stage_phase_definition.prefill_output_consumed: diagnostic only: submit boundary through completion of the output-producing PREFILL AsyncGPUBeamOutput; includes async lookahead queue delay
stage_phase_definition.average: arithmetic mean over post-canonical diagnostic observations
stage_phase_definition.decode_cache_semantics: common phase; miss/hit are repeated observations, not additive components
stage_phase_definition.device_state_semantics: Prefill and Decode are CUDA device-timeline intervals on a single FIFO compute stream; they are additive and sum with host_overhead back to e2e
